blockingFindings.finding: BASE.parents[4] points to repository/docs from nested candidate_r001; PRIOR becomes docs/docs/production/... and load_helper fails reading snapshot_r421_r002.py before argument handling.
blockingFindings.minimumFix: Resolve the worktree root explicitly or use BASE.parents[5], then revalidate pinned helper path and hash.

additionalFindings.finding: Cold relaunch is followed by a fixed 0.5-second delay and immediate snapshot/screenshot, without a readiness handshake; byte equality alone does not prove the restored UI was ready/visible.
Evidence byte cap is checked before the screenshot, but not after it; capture can cross the 180MB cap.

positiveChecks: The helper pins R420 install/build receipts and exact initial save SHA through the imported R421 read-only helper.
Lifecycle termination is restricted to PIDs recorded by helper launch receipts and exact pinned executable command paths.
Save/support snapshots use stable double reads and do not write the game save; app and protected-tree hashes are compared at close.
